current_protocol_contract.name: formal_sgd_warmup_cosine_mosaic_v1
current_protocol_contract.exact_resume_rule: The epoch-6 checkpoint can exactly resume only the same 300-epoch protocol. Changing total epochs changes total optimizer steps, cosine LR values, protocol metadata, and protocol hash.
current_protocol_contract.short_schedule_rule: Any shorter cosine schedule must be a separate experiment in a new output directory using the epoch-6 or later checkpoint as weights-only init-checkpoint, never resume.

recommended_staged_plan.action: Completed one CPU diagnostic over all 5000 known COCO validation images for the frozen epoch-6 checkpoint.
recommended_staged_plan.decision_use: The full 5000-image result, not the preliminary 256-image subset, is the bound baseline for all later COCO gates. This remains diagnostic and is not road or formal-newtest acceptance.

recommended_staged_plan.action: Resume the existing 300-epoch run without changing any protocol field and pause only after the complete epoch-10 checkpoint is written.
continue_if: No NaN or Inf and all four new epochs finish at complete epoch boundaries.
On the complete 5000-image COCO validation set with the same metric implementation, person AP50 is no lower than 0.18616605745138154 and vehicle AP50 is no lower than 0.05606134302753632.
The lower of the two complete-validation class AP50 values improves by at least 0.01 absolute over the epoch-6 full-validation baseline.
recommended_staged_plan.stop_if: Any continue condition fails; investigate data, loss assignment, or optimization before spending more GPU time.

recommended_staged_plan.action: Only after C1 passes, resume the same 300-epoch run to the complete epoch-15 checkpoint.
continue_if: The lower of the two class AP50 values improves by at least 0.01 absolute over epoch 10.
Neither class recall at score 0.5 drops by more than 0.01 absolute from epoch 10.
recommended_staged_plan.stop_if: The curve is flat or regresses; do not assume more epochs alone will recover it.

recommended_staged_plan.action: Only after C2 passes, resume the same 300-epoch run to the complete epoch-20 checkpoint, then stop COCO pretraining for a domain-adaptation decision.
recommended_staged_plan.selection_rule: Among epochs 6, 10, 15, and 20, choose the checkpoint with the highest minimum per-class AP50 on the bound validation set; break ties by the higher minimum per-class recall at score 0.5.

recommended_staged_plan.action: Create a new 40-epoch supervised road-development experiment from the selected COCO checkpoint using weights-only init-checkpoint, a new output directory, all 19050 train frames, and all 5151 validation frames.
recommended_staged_plan.reason_for_40_epochs: It keeps the fixed five-epoch warmup and leaves 25 Mosaic epochs followed by the required final 15 Mosaic-off epochs. A 20-epoch total would leave only five Mosaic epochs and is a materially different augmentation balance.

road_time_extrapolation.warning: This is a cautious throughput extrapolation, not a promise. The road pool has many more boxes per frame, different I/O, and different loss-assignment cost. Teacher distillation and QAT are excluded.

recommended_staged_plan.gate_rule: Use the fixed 256-image public-road diagnostic and its evaluated-image hash as the fast baseline, then evaluate the known full development split for selected checkpoints. Continue only while the minimum per-class AP50 improves by at least 0.01 absolute over the prior gate and neither class recall at score 0.5 regresses by more than 0.01. Select by the same minimum-per-class rule used in C3.
recommended_staged_plan.acceptance_limitation: This public pool is development evidence only. It is not the missing formal newtest and cannot by itself establish P95/R85.

recommended_staged_plan.action: Only after a float road checkpoint shows useful development AP, create a separate 10-epoch teacher-cache distillation pilot from that checkpoint using weights-only init, bounded cache shards, and no Mosaic because current teacher keys are per image.
recommended_staged_plan.gate_rule: At epochs 2 and 5 require finite losses, valid teacher-cache binding, and no greater than 0.01 absolute regression in minimum per-class AP50 from the float baseline. At epoch 10, permit one additional 10-epoch distillation block only if minimum per-class AP50 is at least 0.01 absolute above the float baseline and neither class recall at score 0.5 is below its float baseline. Otherwise stop distillation.
recommended_staged_plan.warning: Teacher inference is 1024x576 and has different storage and compute costs; current one-hour COCO epochs cannot be used as its time promise.

recommended_staged_plan.action: Keep QAT fail-closed until every required activation scale, lookup-table behavior, and integer reference contract exists. When they exist, create one separate 30-epoch QAT protocol and treat its first five complete epochs as the bounded smoke stage.
recommended_staged_plan.continue_rule: At every gate require finite training, complete integer-reference checks, and per-class/macro mAP50 degradation no greater than 0.01 absolute relative to the frozen same-topology float baseline. Stop at the first failed gate; do not automatically run to epoch 30.
recommended_staged_plan.acceptance_gate: The final selected QAT checkpoint and integer deployment flow must remain within the frozen one-percentage-point mAP50 limit relative to the same-topology float model.

protocol_preserving_time_options.effect: Avoids committing to the remaining 294 epochs before metric evidence exists.
protocol_preserving_time_options.constraint: Resume only the same 300-epoch protocol and only from complete epoch checkpoints.

protocol_preserving_time_options.effect: May reduce host input stalls without changing samples or optimizer math.
protocol_preserving_time_options.constraint: Adopt only after proving identical sample order, exact preprocessed tensors, box/ignore tensors, and first-step losses. No speedup has yet been measured, so none is promised.

protocol_preserving_time_options.effect: Could avoid repeated raw JPEG decode, 1280x720 letterbox, and integer resize. Mosaic can still consume the exact cached full-frame 512x288 pixels before its half-size composition.
protocol_preserving_time_options.constraint: The 15.731x result is preprocessing-only and does not predict full training throughput. A full uncompressed COCO-train RGB cache is rejected: 52326383616 bytes, about 48.73 GiB, cannot fit while retaining a 20 GiB disk reserve with only about 56.21 GB free on E. A road-train cache is 8427110400 bytes, about 7.85 GiB, and all road train plus validation is 10705747968 bytes, about 9.97 GiB; those are disk-feasible with the reserve but not safe as fully resident memory replicated across four Windows workers on a host with about 15.71 GiB physical RAM. A production disk-block reader must preserve exact pre-Mosaic bytes and prove unchanged training behavior; disk throughput and full-epoch speed remain unmeasured.

protocol_preserving_time_options.evidence: Epoch 6 spent approximately 54.6 seconds after the last logged training step within a 3571.4-second epoch, so the maximum observed saving is only about 1.5 percent and would weaken monitoring. Detection diagnostics are already CPU-bound and can remain outside GPU training.

changes_requiring_explicit_revised_proto: Changing total epoch count or cosine schedule.
Changing five-epoch warmup, final-15 Mosaic shutdown, batch, accumulation, sampling order, or seed.
Switching from COCO to the public road dataset.
Teacher distillation, including its required no-Mosaic behavior.
Changing the per-class Top-K or final output cap from 32, which also requires postprocess, RTL, memory, timing, and resource review.
Changing topology or 512x288 resolution; this plan rejects both as time shortcuts.
Dropping dense frames or any labeled GT; this plan rejects both as invalid metric manipulation.

public_road_pool_evidence.capacity_conclusion: With the frozen cap of 32 vehicle outputs per frame, this dense validation split has a hard vehicle recall ceiling of 64.678 percent even for a perfect model, so R85 is impossible on this split. Keep it as an honest stress-development set. Do not delete dense frames. Either reserve formal acceptance for a separately collected representative newtest, or explicitly revise the output-cap hardware contract after resource review.

formal_acceptance_blockers: The complete 5000-image epoch-6 COCO diagnostic fails P95/R85; the preliminary 256-image result is retained only as history.
No formal newtest from at least three verified new road cameras is assigned.
Public-video source-family proxies are not verified camera identities.
The current public-road validation vehicle cap32 oracle ceiling is 64.678 percent, below R85.
QAT, integer reference equivalence, RTL integration, FPGA speed, and board tests are not complete.
explicit_non_actions: No GPU training was restarted while producing this plan.
